name: .alpha.-tocopherol + silicon dioxide + sodium fluoride + sodium pyrophosphate
uses: Use(s) • Helps remove plaque and tartar buildup • Helps prevent cavities • Helps reduce gum inflammation and promote healthy teeth
otcwarn: Warnings • Keep out of reach of children under 6 years of age. • If more than used for brushing is accidentally swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
